success: How do I know I learned it?
doneHint: Only check this off once you can do the challenge on your own, or with the docs open.
placeholderText: Click a box on the roadmap to see the challenge and study material.
legendHint: Click a topic to see what to study, the hands-on challenge and links.
sync_offline: Server unavailable: saved in this browser only, will sync when it is back
sync_local: Progress saved in this browser only
sync_auth: Server token required: reload the page and enter the token
syncTokenPrompt: This server asks for a token to save progress. Enter the token:
rmDeleteAsk: Delete “{title}”? The roadmap file will be removed.
rmDeleteWith: Delete and erase progress and notes
rmHideHint: Roadmaps that come from files (the roadmaps/ folder or the examples) are read-only: hiding removes them from the list without deleting the file. Roadmaps made here can be edited and deleted.
rmNoServer: Creating, editing, deleting and hiding roadmaps needs the Roadkit server.
edSuccess: How you know you learned it
edNeedTitle: Give the roadmap a name and write at least one topic.
edHint: Extra fields (labels, optional topics...) live in the JSON tab.
edPreviewEmptyText: Write a topic name to see the roadmap take shape here.
edColorsHint: Blank colors use the default. Each phase color shows on the map and in the sidebar.
edGhostSummary: Topics you add to this phase show up here.
edCategoryNeedName: Give the new category a name.
edCategoryHint: The category is the picker section (a folder). Roadmaps made here sit next to your files of the same category.
importTitle: Import a roadmap and progress .zip, or a JSON
aiHow: Describe what you want, copy the prompt into your favorite AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini...) and bring the answer back. The roadmap opens here in the editor, with the preview next to it.
aiGoal: What do you want to learn or do?
aiGoalPh: E.g. learn Rust from scratch to write command line tools. I have 6 weeks, about 5 hours a week, and I already know Go.
aiAnswerPh: Paste the JSON the AI gave you here (a ```json block is fine).
aiNoJson: I could not find a JSON in that answer.
aiBad: That JSON does not look like a roadmap: meta.title and the nodes list are missing.
aiLoadFail: Could not load the prompt template.
confirmReset: Remove all checkmarks for this roadmap? This applies to every device using this server.
importOkLocal: Roadmap and progress imported. This roadmap was opened from a file: copy it into the roadmaps/ folder to keep it on the server.
installHint: Opens in its own window, with an icon, and keeps working with no internet.
updateReady: A new version of Roadkit is available.
exportZipHint: To take to another Roadkit or keep a copy. It comes back through Import.
exportMdHint: The roadmap as text, with [x] on what is done. Good for a README, Obsidian or an issue.
exportHtmlHint: A single file that opens in any browser with no server: today's map, kanban and progress, read-only.
exportWithNotes: Include my notes in the Markdown and the page
datesHint: Each phase's and topic's date comes from its period ("Weeks 1 and 2", "Month 2"). Dates show on the map and in the panel, and a warning marks what is past due. Dates in the JSON (due) take priority.
paletteSearch: Search a topic, project, roadmap or action…
paletteHint: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close · ? shows the shortcuts
paletteWords_theme: theme colors dark light night mode
paletteWords_settings: settings preferences options theme language font text size
paletteWords_manage: manage hide delete duplicate edit roadmaps
keysHint: Single-letter keys to get around without the mouse. Press ? to see them all.
keysOffNote: Single-letter shortcuts are turned off in the settings; Ctrl+K and Esc still work.
key_status: To do, working, review, finished (open topic or project)
notePh: Write down what you learned, a command that worked, a question, a decision. Markdown works: **bold**, - lists, - [ ] tasks, `code`, [links](https://…).
note_offline: Server unavailable: saved in this browser, will sync when it is back
note_auth: The server needs the token: reload the page and enter it
notesNone: No topic or project has notes yet. Write in the panel of any of them.
projectsReadyOnly: Only the ones I can start now
projectMissingOne: You have not finished 1 of the topics this project uses yet.
projectMissingMany: You have not finished {n} of the topics this project uses yet.
stretchHint: Extra challenges for when you want to push further. Check the ones you take on; they do not count toward finishing the project.
repoInvalid: Use a link that starts with http:// or https://.
projectReadyToast: The project “{title}” is within reach now. Open
aiProjects: Include hands-on projects, from beginner to advanced
kanbanHint: Drag cards between columns or use the arrows. Finishing a topic finishes all of its tasks.
skipWarnHint: Flags a card when a topic moves ahead without finishing the ones before it.
skipWarnOne: 1 earlier topic is still not finished:
skipWarnMany: {n} earlier topics are still not finished:
todayContinueEmpty: Nothing in progress. When you move a topic or project to "in progress" or "in review", it shows up here.
todayNextHint: The next topic of each roadmap you used in the last 30 days.
todayNextEmpty: No other roadmap used in the last 30 days.
todayStartHint: No recent activity yet. This is the next topic of the last roadmap you opened.
homeHint: The Today screen gathers what is in progress and the next topic of each roadmap.
key_today: Open or close the Today screen
paletteWords_today: today now continue progress day home dashboard
reviewHint: Finished main topics come back for review on the Today screen after 3, 7, 21, 60 and 150 days.
todayReviewHint: Do you still remember? Each "I still remember" pushes the next review further.
reviewAgainHint: Moves the topic back to "in review", opens it and starts the intervals over
reviewDoneToast: {title} left the review queue. It stuck!
focusHint: A timer started from a topic or project; every session of 5 minutes or more is recorded on it.
focusNotify: Notify me when it ends (browser notification)
focusNotifyDenied: The browser did not allow notifications; the sound still plays.
focusBtnTitle: Start a focus session on this item
focusTooShort: Under 5 minutes: this session was not recorded.
focusReplace: A focus session is already running. Stop it and start another?
statForecast: At the pace of the last 4 weeks, it ends around {date}
statForecastSoon: The forecast shows up after two weeks of activity.
statForecastStill: No topic finished in the last 4 weeks, so there is no end date to forecast yet.
statsEmpty: Statistics show up as you check off topics. The activity record started in version 1.7.
paletteWords_stats: statistics stats chart pace forecast streak heatmap history
demoBanner: Demo: your progress stays in this browser only.
demoInstall: Install Roadkit to keep it for real →
